sources: Benjamin Netanyahu, interview with Mark Levin on FOX News; Eastora cites 2026 US intelligence assessment
fault_line: Nine days before the Israeli election: is Netanyahu warning America of a real ICBM threat, or borrowing the threat to win votes and lock Trump's war posture?

sections.what_happened: Netanyahu said Iran is developing intercontinental ballistic missiles and pursuing nuclear weapons 'to reach the United States': 'You are the real target.' 'Every single city in the U.S. will be held hostage.' Also said Hamas, Hezbollah, Ansar Allah are 'arms of this toxic octopus' (Iran), and framed goals if reelected: end Iran threat, expand Abraham Accords, lead AI. Eastora counterpoint: the 2026 US intelligence assessment says Iran has demonstrated space-launch tech that could begin developing a militarily viable ICBM before 2035 IF Tehran chose — it does not say Iran currently possesses an operational ICBM.
sections.what_verified: JPost, Matzav, Newsrael, Axar.az, Eastora all carry the interview quotes verbatim; clip circulating (Clash Report)
sections.what_disputed: 2026 US intel assessment (via Eastora): no current operational Iranian ICBM capable of reaching the US; ~2035 earliest even if pursued. Interview aired 10 days before Oct 27 Israeli election — campaign context. Netanyahu made a similar 'year away from ICBMs' claim during the March war.
sections.why_matters: The claim on screen word-for-word, then the intelligence assessment underneath it. Truth-side rule: we stand with verified evidence — if the assessment says no operational ICBM, that is the headline's counterweight.
sections.context: Background: Netanyahu FOX News 'Life, Liberty & Levin' interview (aired Sat Oct 17): Iran developing ICBMs to target US cities; US intel assessment cited as counterpoint

totw_analysis: Our read: The claim on screen word-for-word, then the intelligence assessment underneath it. Truth-side rule: we stand with verified evidence — if the assessment says no operational ICBM, that is the headline's counterweight. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Nine days before the Israeli election: is Netanyahu warning America of a real ICBM threat, or borrowing the threat to win votes and lock Trump's war posture?
